newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Sydney Casino sees Dec qtr profit up.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Sydney Casino sees Dec qtr profit up.

text.p: Sydney Harbour Casino Ltd chairman Dick Warburton said he expected the casino operator's profits to be stronger in the three months to December compared with the September quarter.
Asked whether he expected the profit improvement to come before or after tax, Warburton told Reuters: "I hope to see it all over."
Sydney Harbour Casino earlier reported a pre-tax and before abnormal items profit of A$14.7 million in the September quarter, while profit after tax and abnormals was A$200,000 for the quarter.
"We shouldn't have those abnormals. That abnormal was a one-off cost," Warburton told Reuters after the annual general meeting of Goldfields Ltd, a company of which he is a director.
Sydney Harbour Casino, about 26 percent owned by Showboat Inc, reported an abnormal charge of A$2 million in the September quarter.
Warburton said the effects of some marketing initiatives started earlier this year had started to show on the operating performance of the casino operator.
He said the December quarter should also be cyclically stronger due to Christmas.
Sydney Casino shares closed five cents lower at A$1.79.
